summaries.Romania: Romania faced security alerts with drone detections near Tulcea and Serpent Island, while domestic economic concerns mounted with public debt surging over 800M lei daily and employment declining in Bucharest. Political tensions emerged around the Neptun Deep dispute and EU security discussions ahead of Ursula von der Leyen's visit.
summaries.Healthcare: Healthcare innovation continued with AI-driven clinical tools and digital health expansions, though major drug trials failed to deliver cardiovascular breakthroughs, raising questions about AI's role in drug discovery. Insurance companies posted strong Q3 results while CMS finalized significant Medicare payment reforms shifting focus to prevention and primary care.
summaries.Tech: Apple continued advancing its AI assistant capabilities with plans to make Siri more proactive, while the broader tech landscape grappled with AI security concerns as coding agents leaked credentials and cybersecurity became increasingly compromised by AI tools. Major hardware releases and platform updates dominated the week alongside growing geopolitical tensions over semiconductor access and AI dominance.

items.title: CMS makes it official, codifying Medicare drug price negotiations established under IRA
